This approach respects the rights of all applicants by avoiding categorical exclusions or prioritizations that could unfairly disadvantage groups like those with uncertain documentation (case1) or climate-displaced individuals (case3). Option A’s strict ≥50% allocation to H and C risks sidelining other legitimate claims, while Option C’s focus on deterrence may infringe on due process rights. Therefore, I lean toward Option B.
